Austria / Zug, Lech am Arlberg

Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel

In Zug, the hamlet just outside Lech am Arlberg. A hotel known for its cooking, with the slopes within easy reach: the Zuger Bergbahn gondola takes you from Zug into the Lech Zürs ski area.

Enquire about this hotelAbout Lech am Arlberg
01 / 08

In short

What to know.

  • 62 rooms and suites, including family suites
  • Heated indoor and outdoor pool and a 1,500 m² spa
  • Ski rental, shop and servicing in the hotel

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For guests who plan the day around lunch and dinner as much as around the snow, and for families who want a quiet base close to the lifts.

Run by the hotel.

The restaurants, the spa and the hotel's activities are run by the hotel.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel, under the hotel's terms.
